_doc: What build-catalog.py may publish, and the licence facts it cannot read from the source. A module publishes when its licence is known: a licence file, the module.json "license" field, a README licence section, or an entry in "licence" below. A module whose code names no licence is all rights reserved and is withheld; an entry in "publish" (with the permission it rests on) publishes it anyway.

jp8000.note: The repository names no licence of its own; the emulator it is built on (gearmulator, libs/gearmulator) is GPL-3.0, so the whole is distributed under the GPL-3.0.

withhold.stacks: its repository is still private: Pung publishes the source of what it ships (take this line out when rgeissen/schwung-stacks is public)
withhold.viz: a light show for grid controllers and Move's remote UI: nothing it does reaches a device in Live
withhold.chord-display: shows the chord on Move's own screen: in Live, Push and Live show chords themselves
withhold.elusive-muse: prompts on Move's screen, drawn by its jog wheel: nothing for a device in Live
withhold.scratch: played with Move's jog wheel or Serato control vinyl: neither reaches a device in Live on the Push
withhold.strut: its licence is PolyForm Strict 1.0.0 (no distribution, no changes): Pung may not ship it
